2608.04808.title: A Modular Part-of-Speech Tagger for Scottish Gaelic using spaCy
2608.04808.paper_summary: Part-of-speech tagging for low-resource languages remains challenging due to limited annotated data, especially for linguistically complex languages. Gaidhlig (Scottish Gaelic) is a morphologically rich and endangered language with limited digital resources, making it suitable for examining a lightweight language processing approach. This paper describes using the modular spaCy Natural Language Processing framework to build part-of-speech taggers for Gaidhlig using the Annotated Reference Corpus of Scottish Gaelic. We train two models with minimal pre-processing and configuration: one using a fine-grained tagset and another using a reduced coarse-grained tagset. Both models are trained without external embeddings or pre-trained language models, using only supervised learning from the available corpus. The fine-grained model achieves 88.6% tagging accuracy, while the coarse-grained model achieves 93.7%. The results are comparable to those of the two previously published Gaidhlig taggers, indicating that simple, off-the-shelf language processing pipelines can demonstrate good performance in low-resource and morphologically complex linguistic settings.
2608.04808.paper_summary_zh: 低資源語言的詞性標註仍然面臨挑戰，因為註釋數據有限，尤其是對於語言學上複雜的語言。Gaidhlig（蘇格蘭蓋爾語）是一種形態學豐富且瀕危的語言，數位資源有限，這使其適合用來檢驗輕量級語言處理方法。本文描述了使用模組化的spaCy自然語言處理框架，基於蘇格蘭蓋爾語的註釋參考語料庫來構建Gaidhlig的詞性標註器。我們訓練了兩個模型，進行最小的預處理和配置：一個使用細粒度標籤集，另一個使用簡化的粗粒度標籤集。這兩個模型均在沒有外部嵌入或預訓練語言模型的情況下進行訓練，僅使用可用語料庫的監督學習。細粒度模型達到了88.6%的標註準確率，而粗粒度模型達到了93.7%。這些結果與之前發表的兩個Gaidhlig標註器的結果相當，表明簡單的現成語言處理管道在低資源和形態學複雜的語言環境中能夠展現良好的性能。
